name: Roland SH-201

sources.title: Roland SH-201 MIDI Implementation
sources.notes: Broad DT1/RQ1 profile generated from the SH-201 MIDI implementation. It includes declarative DT1 dump definitions generated from documented address ranges; captured hardware dumps should be added as tests before marking the profile verified.

description: Roland SH-201 device profile generated from the MIDI implementation. Large profile: use search, group filters, and edit-source mode in the DPD.
authoringNotes: Large profile: DPD should use paged parameter loading and backend filtering.
Arpeggio Pattern parameters are intentionally grouped by pattern block; they are advanced editing targets.
DT1 dump parsing definitions are generated from documented address ranges; captured hardware dumps should be added as parse tests.
